gist.summary: Added @Saauf’s Switchyard to the games catalog and README’s recent-apps list. The web game has players choose first in six trolley dilemmas, compare their choices with Jev, then reverse the description order; it also offers free practice, exact prompts, probabilities, and session export. Model Match moved out of the limited recent-apps list.

image.prompt: At a cozy pixel-art garden railway, Polli wears a tiny conductor’s cap and studies a track switch beside six little dilemma cards, while a single CRT monitor robot holds two cards in reversed order; lime green (#ecf874) flowers glow around them against a warm cream and pastel background. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. She is small-to-medium sized within the scene, sharing the frame with other elements, never oversized or dominating the image; strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
